method.method_draft: Read from the image that the triangle has base 6 mm and perpendicular height 2 mm. Imagine making a congruent copy of the triangle and fitting the two copies together to form a parallelogram with the same base 6 mm and height 2 mm. The parallelogram area would be 6 × 2 = 12, so the original triangle has half that area, 12/2 = 6.
